notes.content:
・Mirror mode is added.
When enabled, the screen is reversed from left to right. (Player controls are the same as usual.)

・Added a new achievement.
Achievements will be completed when mirror mode is enabled.

notes.title: Patch 1.04 -- Fixing
notes.content:
・The difficulty of some stages changes greatly depending on the effect settings, so the effect settings have been changed.
・Fixed a bug in Stage4 that HP and ammo counts were fully recovered.
・Added more Japanese text in the UI.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 -- Fixed Issue with Achievement Not Counting
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the achievement "God of Camper" would not be unlocked even after meeting the required conditions.
Despite being the most challenging achievement in the game, there was an issue where it wouldn’t be recorded even when the conditions were met. I sincerely apologize for this. The problem occurred because the process of retrieving and recording achievement status was interrupted by level transitions before it could be completed. This was an oversight on my part.

To ensure achievements are properly recorded, I’ve implemented a more redundant system. Now, the achievement will be securely recorded when you clear StageFinal and the results screen is displayed.

Reference:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3069490/discussions/0/4518884534205210934/]"God of Camper" achievement[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 -- Added Graphics Settings and Adjusted Weapon Balance
notes.content:
Added options to change graphics settings.
I have also adjusted weapon balance. The goal was not to lower difficulty, but to reduce stress. Horizontal recoil has been removed, and accuracy has been improved.
I hope you feel a better experience with the guns.

※I plan to add a mode that is easier to play casually, separate from the current difficulty.
※If you prefer the current balance or have already completed it, you can still play with this balance.

■Feature Additions
Added options to change window resolution and graphic quality. These settings can be adjusted from the title screen and pause menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082807/a79a54444fad2877e29c831c0fdbc134053e972d.png[/img]

■Weapon Balance Adjustments
[All Weapons]
Changed accuracy penalty while moving from 500 to 100.

[Weapon 1]
Changed from semi-auto to full-auto. The firing rate remains unchanged.
・Recoil adjustments:
  Left recoil: 0.15 → 0.0
  Right recoil: 0.15 → 0.0

[Weapon 2: AR]
・Recoil adjustments:
  Left recoil: 0.2 → 0.0
  Right recoil: 0.3 → 0.0

[Weapon 3: SG]
・Recoil adjustments:
  Left recoil: 1.0 → 0.0
  Right recoil: 1.0 → 0.0

[Weapon 4: SMG]
・Recoil adjustments:
  Vertical recoil (max): 0.38 → 0.25
  Vertical recoil (min): 0.35 → 0.2
※Only SMGs have had their accuracy slightly reduced. I may change this in a future update after seeing how it goes.

[Weapon 5: SR]
・Recoil adjustments:
  Left recoil: 0.3 → 0.0
  Right recoil: 0.0

■Fixes
Changed the score addition process to complete instantly when a round starts during score calculation.

notes.title: Release Note!
notes.content:
I have released Master of Shotgun Camper!
I was thinking a lot about making a FPS that can be played solo, and this is what I came up with.

The difficulty adjustment is quite severe in terms of the game system, and it may be too difficult for some people, or on the contrary, too easy for others......
The difficulty varies depending on whether you use a shotgun or a sniper.
If you want to complete the stages from 1 to 10, please be careful about the number of ammunition you have left.

I want the game to be played casually, so I have quietly implemented a function to unlock all stages.
There is a small button in the lower right corner of the stage select screen, so feel free to press it.
Simply pressing the button does not count as an achievement. I want you to play from any stage you like.

I have included a Steam ranking function and an achievement function.
I would be happy if the sense of accomplishment or enjoyment has increased even a little.

I would appreciate it if you could point out any bugs, etc. in the comments of this post or in the Google Form below.

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LBlTwdlBreMAixkAlRxXH6c9vi6Ywtm57JWgAf8Iodk/]Google Form：[Report]Master of Shotgun Camper[/url]
